results.rationale: Consistency: white cat, pink nose, dark eyes, seated pose and curled tail are retained, but fur detail and facial proportions are visibly redrawn. Instruction: pink/blue gradient, bright pink Pet Home title, paws and hearts are present; cat is made smaller rather than slightly enlarged, and the tagline is white handwritten text above the cat rather than light-gray sans-serif below. Quality: readable main typography and coherent cat, but several decorative marks near the tail and right end of the tagline are malformed.

Consistency: white background and retained upper forks preserve the silver material and layout; the top tine tips are now slightly cropped. Instruction: forks are reduced from eight to four rather than the requested six, so count reduction is attempted but inaccurate. Quality: smooth coherent handles and tines; clipping the upper tine tips is a small composition imperfection.
